Reference

Requirements for developer tooling

This page lists every requirement with the prefix DEV. Each row gives the id, the statement, the page that defines it and a way to test it. The tests for the plugin command line, the check and lint rules, the project templates, the test harness, the conformance suite, the debugging tools and the CI and documentation guides are written from this table.

Words: MUST and MUST NOT are required. SHOULD is expected unless a reason is recorded. MAY is allowed. An id is never reused. The statement here is the same text as on the page. If the two differ, the page wins and this table has a defect.

You will need

  • The pages named in the "Page" column. Each id appears there as [DEV-nnn] at the start of a bullet.
  • A scratch project made with ilium plugin new. See Project templates.

How to read the table

  • The id ranges are fixed by area. See the area headings below.
  • "Testable how" says what a test does. It is a method, not a test case.
  • Rows are grouped by area and sorted by id.

CLI conventions

Id Statement Page Testable how
DEV-001 <dir> MUST default to the current working directory. A command that takes <dir> MUST treat it as the project directory, the one that holds manifest.json. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-002 A command that builds MUST detect the language from the project files. A Cargo.toml means Rust. A package.json means TypeScript. Both files together fail with toolchain.language-ambiguous. Neither file fails with toolchain.language-unknown. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-003 Every command MUST accept the global flags in the table below. A flag that does not apply to a command MUST be accepted and ignored, except --session, which a command that never contacts a session MUST also ignore without error. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-004 A session command MUST find its session this way: the session named by --session, in the project that --cwd names, defaulting to the session called default of the current directory. No session found at that address MUST fail with session.unreachable and exit code 6. A command MUST NOT start a session itself. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-005 The commands in the offline column of the table below MUST work with no running session, no network and no home-directory configuration beyond the trust store. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-006 A session command that cannot reach its session MUST print one error record with the code session.unreachable, then summary, then result, and exit with 6. It MUST NOT retry. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-007 Every command MUST exit with one of the codes below, and the exit_code field of its result record MUST equal the process exit code. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-008 Exit code 0 MUST be returned only when result.ok is true. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-009 Exit code 1 MUST be returned for any failure that is not covered by a more specific code. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-010 Exit code 2 MUST be returned for a usage error before any work starts. The command MUST NOT write files before it returns 2. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-011 Exit code 3 MUST be returned when a check finding of severity error exists, when lint --deny warnings has any finding, when a lint rule of severity error fires, or when at least one test case does not pass. A finding of severity warn under check or plain lint returns 0. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-012 Exit code 4 MUST be returned when a toolchain.* code stops the command, and when doctor reports any item with status fail. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-013 Exit code 5 MUST be returned for plugin.not-found, trust.not-found and inspect.id-unknown. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-014 Exit code 6 MUST be returned for session.unreachable and session.not-found. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-015 Exit code 130 MUST be returned after an interrupt. The command MUST print summary and result with ok set to false before it exits, and MUST leave no half-written output file (see the atomic write rule below). reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-016 A JSONL command MUST print one JSON object per line on standard output, with the field type as the first key. Human text, if any, MUST go to standard error. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-017 A JSONL command MUST print exactly one summary record and then exactly one result record, in that order, as its last two lines. This fixes the older disagreement between pages. The summary comes first, and the result is always the final line, so a script can read the last line to get the outcome. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-018 Every size MUST be an unsigned integer in bytes. Every duration MUST be an unsigned integer in milliseconds, and its key MUST end in _ms. Every hash MUST be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters of SHA-256. Every path MUST use / and be relative to the project directory unless the key says absolute. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-019 A record MUST NOT contain a field that this page does not define for its type, except details, an optional object that a record MAY carry. A consumer MUST ignore fields it does not know, so later minor versions can add fields. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-020 --quiet MUST suppress progress records and nothing else. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-021 The step field of progress MUST be one of toolchain, compile, bundle, component, api-version, strip, inventory, pack, sign, check, lint, test, install, watch. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-022 The kind field of artifact MUST be one of component, package, source-map, build-info, key, public-key, signature, replay. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-023 The severity field of check and lint MUST be error or warn. A lint record MAY also use info. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-024 The status field of test-case MUST be pass, fail, trap or skipped. The status field of doctor-check MUST be ok, warn or fail. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-025 The side field MUST be server, client, scene or host. host marks an entry that the host itself wrote. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-026 A command listed as JSONL in the table below MUST print JSONL always. --json on such a command MUST be accepted and have no effect. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-027 A command listed as text MUST print text by default for a person and JSONL with --json. The JSONL form MUST end with summary and result records, as for any JSONL command. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-028 Text output MUST be stable enough to read but is not a contract. Scripts MUST use --json. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-029 A flag MUST override the environment variable that has the same effect. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-030 Output files that a command replaces (dist/*.wasm, the package, the signature, golden files, replay files) MUST be written to a temporary file in the same folder and renamed into place, so an interrupt never leaves a half-written file. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code

CLI commands

Id Statement Page Testable how
DEV-040 new MUST require --id, --lang and one of --template or --side. If both are given, they MUST name the same template, or the command fails with usage.conflict. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-041 new MUST fail with new.dir-not-empty when <dir> exists and holds any file, unless --force is given. With --force it MUST overwrite only files that the template writes and MUST leave every other file alone. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-042 new MUST fail with new.id-invalid for an id that does not match the pattern, and with new.id-reserved for an ilium. id without --first-party. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-043 new MUST fail with new.template-unknown for an unknown template name, before it writes any file. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-044 new MUST print one progress record with step inventory for each file it writes, and the message MUST be the relative path of the file. It needs no network and no toolchain, and it writes no artifact record. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-045 A fresh project MUST pass check, lint --deny warnings, test and build with zero warnings, as the template guarantees state. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-050 build MUST read manifest.json, build every declared side and write dist/<side>.wasm for each. With --side, a side that the manifest does not declare MUST fail with build.side-undeclared. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-051 build MUST print one artifact record of kind component per side, one of kind build-info for dist/build.json, and, for a --debug build, one of kind source-map per side for TypeScript. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-052 build --watch MUST build once, then watch the project and rebuild 300 ms after the last change. It MUST NOT install, activate or contact a session. The watch set and its ignore rules are the ones of dev. A failed rebuild MUST print its errors and keep watching. --watch ends only on interrupt, with exit code 130. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-053 --locked MUST fail with build.lockfile-missing when Cargo.lock or bun.lock is missing, and with build.lockfile-outdated when building would change it. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-054 --offline MUST fail with build.offline-missing when a dependency is not in the local cache. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-055 build MUST exit with 4 when the toolchain is missing, and with 1 for a compile, bundle or component failure. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-070 check MUST run offline and MUST report the same rule codes (manifest.*) that the install path reports (the install path uses no package.* codes), plus the component rules (component.*, signature.*) of DEV-201. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-071 check on a project directory MUST validate the source manifest and the built components in dist/. A missing dist/ for a declared side MUST be reported as component.missing, not as an error of the command. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-072 check on a .iliumpkg file MUST validate the archive as the install path does, without checking trust. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-073 check MUST exit with 3 when any finding has severity error. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-075 lint MUST run offline and MUST report only lint.* rules. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-076 --deny warnings MUST turn every warn finding into an error for the exit code. Without it a warn finding returns 0. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-077 --rule <id> MUST restrict the run to the named rules. An unknown id MUST fail with usage.invalid-value. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-078 A suppressed finding MUST be printed with suppressed: true and MUST NOT count toward the exit code. Suppression is described in the rules page. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-080 test MUST run in component mode: it loads the built component into the embedded test host, with the real linker, limits and deadlines. A project with no dist/ component for the side MUST fail with test.component-missing. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-081 test MUST print for each fixture one test-case record, and for each submission and outcome produced a submission and an outcome record, in delivery order, before the test-case record of that fixture. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-082 If an expectation file exists, test MUST compare it with the result using the match modes of the harness page. On a mismatch it MUST print a diff record, set the test-case status to fail, and exit with 3. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-083 A fixture with no expectation file MUST pass unless the component traps. It MUST print warning code test.no-expectation. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-084 A component trap during a fixture MUST set the status trap, print the trap reason in reason, and exit with 3. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-085 A package with a server and a client side MUST be given --side, or test MUST fail with usage.missing-argument. A project with one side needs no --side. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-086 --update MUST rewrite only the expectation and golden files that differ, and MUST print a warning with the code test.updated for each file rewritten. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-087 test MUST exit with 0 when every case passes, with 3 when a case fails or traps, and with 1 when a fixture cannot be read (test.fixture-invalid). reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-088 --record <file> MAY be given with --fixture. It MUST write the replay file of the run and print an artifact of kind replay. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-089 test MUST NOT run the project's own unit tests. Those run with cargo test or bun test in native mode. test --coverage is the one case where the command starts them, and it MUST then print their exit status in the summary. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-095 pack MUST refuse a missing or stale dist/. It reads dist/build.json and compares the input hash recorded there with the current sources. A difference MUST fail with pack.stale-build. A missing component MUST fail with pack.not-built. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-096 pack MUST refuse a debug build with pack.debug-build, unless --allow-debug is given, in which case it MUST print a warning with the same code. A debug build is one whose build.json has profile debug. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-097 pack MUST write the files list into the packed manifest, with the length and lowercase SHA-256 of every entry other than manifest.json and signature. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-098 pack MUST NOT store src/** unless --include-src is given. With it, pack MUST store the sources named by the project's src/ folder and the source maps of a debug build under src/. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-099 pack MUST be reproducible. Two runs on the same inputs MUST produce byte-identical files. The archive format already fixes entry order, timestamps and compression (see Packages). reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-100 pack MUST NOT sign. The default output path is dist/<id>-<version>.iliumpkg, and the command prints one artifact of kind package. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-101 pack MUST fail with package.size-limit when the package is larger than 300 MiB (the package format cap, PKG-130), and MUST print a warning with the separate code pack.size-cap at 100 MiB. See lint.package-size-near-cap. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-102 pack --out <file> MUST refuse to overwrite a file that is not a package of the same id, with pack.out-exists. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-110 keygen MUST create publisher.key (PKCS#8 PEM, mode 0600) and publisher.pub (ilium-pub/1 JSON) with Ed25519, as defined in Signing and trust. It MUST refuse to overwrite either file with trust.key-exists. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-111 The file forms of the secret and public key are defined only in Signing and trust (requirements PKG-210 to PKG-215). reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-112 The fingerprint of a key is its key_id, the lowercase hexadecimal SHA-256 of the 32 raw public-key bytes (64 characters). The display form has 16 groups of 4 characters. The short form is the first 8 digits, for example 3f2a91c0, shown only beside the full form or in trust list (SEC-177). reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-115 sign MUST read the key from --key, or from ILIUM_PLUGIN_SIGNING_KEY. With neither, it MUST fail with usage.missing-argument. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-116 sign MUST fail with sign.key-permissions when the key file is readable by group or others on a system that has such permissions, and with sign.key-unreadable when the key cannot be parsed. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-117 sign MUST add the signature entry atomically, as an ilium-sig/1 document over the exact bytes of manifest.json, as defined in Signing and trust. The package stays deterministic: signing twice with the same key gives the same bytes. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-118 sign MUST fail with sign.publisher-mismatch when the publisher in the manifest differs from the key's publisher, and with sign.already-signed when a signature exists and --replace is not given. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-119 sign MUST NOT print the secret key, and the key MUST NOT appear in any record. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-125 The trust store is the file trust.json (format ilium-trust/1) described in Signing and trust, at $XDG_STATE_HOME/ilium/trust.json (macOS and Windows: the state folder of [SEC-112]), or at the path in ILIUM_TRUST_STORE when set. reference-plugin-cli Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-126 trust add MUST print the fingerprint. It MUST fail with trust.key-malformed for a malformed key file, and with trust.already-trusted for a key already listed (exit code 1). reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-127 trust remove <key_id> MUST fail with trust.not-found (exit code 5) when no such key is listed, and with trust.in-use when installed plugins depend on it and --force is absent. Removing a key does not uninstall plugins signed with it. The plugins stay installed and show untrusted in list. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-128 trust list MUST print the publisher, the short fingerprint and the date, one per line, in text mode. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-135 ilium plugin publish <file> --registry <url> uploads a signed package to a registry. It is defined in Distribution commands (decision D27). Without --registry it MUST fail with usage.missing-argument and exit 2. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-136 A package file, the file publisher.pub and the SHA-256 of the package remain a complete way to share a plugin without a registry. An update from a file is found when the user installs a package of the same id with a higher version. reference-plugin-cli Run the command in a scratch project and assert the output and exit code
DEV-140 install MUST run the validation pipeline of Package format before it runs any plugin code, print every failure as an error with the code of that pipeline, and exit with the code of Distribution commands. Sources other than a file are defined there. reference-plugin-cli Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-141 install MUST show the review dialog in the attached client unless --yes is given. Conformance suite

Id Statement Page Testable how
DEV-600 --subject plugin MUST run only the cases marked plugin in the catalogue below. It MUST skip cases that need a grant the plugin does not request, with the reason grant-not-requested. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-601 --subject sdk and --subject host MUST be refused with exit 2 and usage.subject-unavailable in a normal install. They are available only in the Ilium source tree, where the maintainer enables them with ILIUM_CONFORMANCE_MAINTAINER=1. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-602 The suite MUST print one conformance record per case, then a summary record. A fail verdict makes the exit code 3. A suite with only pass and skip exits 0. reference-conformance-suite Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-603 --case <id> MUST run one case. An unknown id MUST fail with exit 2 and usage.invalid-value. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-604 The case ids MUST be stable. A case MUST NOT change meaning. A changed rule gets a new case id, and the old id is retired in the retired list at the end of this page. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-605 Every case MUST be deterministic. It MUST use the fake clock and the default seed. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-606 One case MUST finish within 10,000 ms of wall time. A longer case is a fail with the message case exceeded 10000 ms. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-607 Durations in case expectations are fake-clock milliseconds, except the call time measured in epoch-based wall-clock milliseconds (fuel is off and never enforces or measures deadlines, per HST-058 and LIF-127). A case that needs a deadline breach MUST use the built-in probe plugin conformance-probe.wasm with its busy-wait import, never the plugin under test. reference-conformance-suite Run the deadline cases and read their duration units and plugin name
DEV-610 The catalogue above MUST be the minimum. A release of the suite MAY add cases and MUST NOT remove a case without a retirement note. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-611 Cases for the restart rule MUST use fake time. No case waits for real seconds. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-612 A case for a limit MUST test the value just under the limit (pass) and the value just over (fail), unless the table says otherwise. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-613 A skip MUST carry a reason: grant-not-requested, side-not-built, subject-mismatch, needs-session or needs-component. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-620 A project case id MUST start with PROJ- so it can never clash with a suite case id. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-621 sample_batch(n) MUST return n valid events for the grants of the host, using the fuzz generator with the host seed. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-622 assert_within_budget(host, kind, millis) MUST compare the recorded time of the last call of that kind with millis. kind is one of 'event', 'render', 'activate' and 'deactivate', and millis is an integer in milliseconds (Rust u32, TypeScript number). It MUST be skipped in native mode with the reason needs-component. reference-conformance-suite Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-624 conformance::case and conformance.case MUST pass a FakeHost for manifest.json in component mode with the default seed to the body. The body MUST NOT build its own host. reference-conformance-suite Run a case and assert the host argument is for manifest.json in component mode
DEV-630 --conformance MUST run in component mode only. It MUST NOT run in native mode, because the limits are not enforced there. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-640 A fail record MUST carry expected and actual fields that describe the difference, as strings of at most 200 characters. reference-conformance-suite Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-641 The summary record MUST list passed, failed, skipped and duration_ms. passed plus failed plus skipped MUST equal the number of case records. reference-conformance-suite Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-642 Case order in the output MUST be the order of the catalogue on this page, area by area. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict
DEV-643 A case that cannot drive the plugin to the claimed state MUST be a skip with the reason subject-mismatch, never a pass. reference-conformance-suite Run the case by id and assert the verdict

DEV-720 Field names in --json records MUST use snake_case and MUST match the table. A new field MAY be added. A field MUST NOT be removed or renamed within contract ilium:plugin@0.1.0. reference-debugging-tools Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-721 Durations MUST be numbers in milliseconds with up to three decimals. Sizes MUST be integers in bytes. reference-debugging-tools Test with a fake session: write log lines, read the trace, inspect the output
DEV-722 Records of one run MUST appear in time order, except summary and result, which come last. reference-debugging-tools Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-725 A recorded trace replayed with ilium plugin test --replay MUST reproduce a deadline trap in component mode when the original call exceeded the deadline, as the recorded host call times are replayed with the fake clock. reference-debugging-tools Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-730 inspect --view for a plugin that is disabled MUST fail with inspect.no-render and exit 1. reference-debugging-tools Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-731 profile of a plugin that is disabled MUST fail with plugin.not-running and exit 1. reference-debugging-tools Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-740 A release pipeline SHOULD run the conformance suite in component mode before it packs: ilium plugin test --conformance. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-741 The tag name SHOULD equal v plus the manifest version. A pipeline step MUST fail when they differ. A shell test is test "v$(ilium plugin inspect --json . \| jq -r .version)" = "$GITHUB_REF_NAME". guide-ci-recipes Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-742 The release MUST publish the SHA-256 of the package next to the package, so a user can compare it. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-743 A CI log MUST be enough to find the cause without a terminal. Every error record MUST carry code, message and, when known, fix. guide-ci-recipes Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-744 pack MUST fail with pack.not-built when a side that the manifest declares has no component in dist/. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result

CI recipes

Id Statement Page Testable how
DEV-760 A CI pipeline SHOULD run the five steps in this order and stop at the first step that fails. The order puts the cheap steps first. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-761 Every command MUST work with no terminal and no session. The commands in this table are all offline commands, so a runner needs no running Ilium. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-762 With --json every command MUST print JSONL on standard output only. Progress text goes to standard error. guide-ci-recipes Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-763 NO_COLOR=1 MUST be set in CI. Commands MUST also disable colour when standard output is not a terminal. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-764 The exit codes MUST be those of Plugin command-line reference. A CI step fails on any non-zero code. Code 3 (findings) from lint fails the pipeline when --deny warnings is set. guide-ci-recipes Run the command and assert the exit code and the error code
DEV-765 The generated file MUST pin each third-party action to a major version tag and MUST read the ilium download URL and hash from repository variables, so no URL is hard coded. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-766 The Install ilium step MUST verify the SHA-256 hash of the download before it runs the file. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-770 A release build MUST be reproducible on the same toolchain version and the same ilium version. dist/build.json records toolchain and input_hash so a reviewer can pick the same versions. guide-ci-recipes Run with --json and assert the records and their field order
DEV-771 A build MUST NOT read the wall clock, the user name, the absolute path of the project or environment variables other than those listed in Plugin command-line reference. Package time stamps are fixed. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-772 The lock file (Cargo.lock or bun.lock) MUST be committed, and CI MUST build with --locked (Rust) or --frozen-lockfile (Bun). build SHOULD pass the flag by itself when the lock file exists, and MUST fail with toolchain.lockfile-missing when it does not exist and --release is set without --locked (exit 4). When --locked is also given, the missing lock file is reported as build.lockfile-missing (exit 1, see DEV-053), so one missing file never yields two codes. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-773 A reviewer check is ilium plugin build --release && ilium plugin pack followed by sha256sum dist/*.iliumpkg. Two runs MUST give the same hash. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-775 The secret key MUST be stored as a CI secret and MUST NOT be written to the repository, the build log or an artifact. ilium plugin sign MUST read the key from --key <file> or from the environment variable ILIUM_PLUGIN_SIGNING_KEY and MUST NOT print it. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-776 pack MUST NOT sign. Signing is a separate step so a pull request build never needs the key. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-777 The pipeline SHOULD verify the signed package with ilium plugin inspect dist/*.iliumpkg --verify and compare the printed fingerprint with the fingerprint published for the plugin. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-778 A forked pull request MUST NOT receive the secret. GitHub and GitLab do this by default for forks. Do not enable secrets for forks. guide-ci-recipes Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result

Documentation conventions

Id Statement Page Testable how
DEV-780 A plugin MUST ship a README, a changelog and one help topic for each contributes.help entry. A project from new already does. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-781 The README MUST list every requested grant with one sentence on why the plugin needs it. The manifest has no field for a reason, so the README is the place. lint.grant-unexplained warns when a grant name does not appear in the README. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-782 The README MUST give the commands to build and test the plugin. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-783 The changelog MUST follow Keep a Changelog headings: Added, Changed, Fixed, Removed. The top section of a release MUST match version in the manifest, or be Unreleased. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-785 A help topic MUST start with a level 1 heading equal to the title in the manifest entry. lint.help-title-mismatch warns otherwise. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-786 A help topic MUST NOT exceed 20 KiB. lint.help-topic-too-large warns for a larger file. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-787 A link help:<topic-id> to a topic that the plugin does not ship MUST be a lint.help-link-broken warning. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-788 A help topic SHOULD name each command, setting and view the plugin adds, so a search in the help viewer finds them. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-790 Every setting row MUST have a help text in the settings schema or a help topic that names the row. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-791 Every command in contributes.commands MUST have a title in sentence case with no final period. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-795 A declared extension point MUST appear in the README or in docs/EXTENDING.md. lint.extension-point-undocumented warns when its id is absent from both. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-796 Dates in the changelog MUST use YYYY-MM-DD. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result
DEV-797 The newest version MUST come first. guide-plugin-documentation Run the pipeline or lint in a scratch project and assert the result

Performance of tooling

Id Statement Page Testable how
DEV-850 Tracing MUST add no more than 5 percent to the time of an event batch, and profiling MUST NOT change call time by more than 5 percent. performance Benchmark on the build host and assert the target
DEV-851 A native-mode harness test of one event batch SHOULD finish in under 10 ms, and a component-mode test in under 100 ms, on the build host, excluding the one-time load of the component. performance Benchmark on the build host and assert the target
DEV-852 ilium plugin check SHOULD finish in under 2 s for a package of 10 MiB or less, and ilium plugin lint in under 5 s. performance Benchmark on the build host and assert the target
DEV-853 ilium plugin dev SHOULD reload a plugin within 1 s after the build finishes, and the debounce of a change is 300 ms. performance Benchmark on the build host and assert the target

Decision codes

The tooling decisions that these requirements rest on are recorded in Design decisions. The code D27 (registry publishing) governs publish, and the codes of the restart rule and of the limits table govern the harness and the conformance cases. A requirement that conflicts with a decision is a defect in the requirement.
